appraisal_events.evidence: je suis brouillé avec les noms, ce qui est bien désagréable, dit-il d'un air de satisfaction
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator notes the mismatch between the duke calling his memory lapse 'disagreeable' while delivering the line with a satisfied air, an ironic detail that undercuts his self-presentation as troubled and instead suggests complacent self-regard.

status_effects.explanation: The ironic gap between his stated words and his satisfied manner lends a mildly critical, comic coloring to his self-image, independent of his role in consulting Mme de Villeparisis.

ambiguities: Le narrateur appears only as narrating/perceiving consciousness in this passage; he is not staged as a social participant here, so he was omitted from scoring despite being on the candidate list.

The duke's turning to Mme de Villeparisis for identification is part of the movement already captured in the accepted annotation (E1); only his separate ironic self-characterization is scored here to avoid restating that event.
